description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin dialog for a 'textarea' form element, including UI configuration and content handling functionalities.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog when shown, optionally setting up content based on selected element.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the logic when the user confirms and saves the textarea element, creating or updating it in the editor.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Configures dialog fields based on existing element attributes.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Applies dialog input to the element being inserted or modified.
